description: A two-channel wavefolder with eight processing modes, two internal LFOs mixed into the folding, and a mode that turns it into an LFO source

params.text: Picks the processing: Bypass, Fold, Quant Fold, Tangent, Half Quant, Ring, S&H-Ish or Wut?, shown as a binary number on the three lamps above it

inputs.text: The signal to be folded, and the source for both channels when the jack below is empty
The signal folded into the second channel; leaving it empty sends the first input through both channels with different internal modulation

outputs.text: The processed second channel, which differs from the first in how much of each internal LFO is mixed into it

notes: with the top input empty the module ignores the mode knob and works as an LFO, the top output carrying one internal sine at ±5V and the bottom output the two sines multiplied together
in Ring mode with both inputs patched, each output is its own input multiplied by the other input shifted down by 5V, clamped to ±5V
the S&H-Ish and Wut? modes are deliberately left un-antialiased, so they alias and glitch
menu: LFO 1 SPEED — sets the rate of the first internal LFO, which is mixed into the folding in every mode
LFO 2 SPEED — sets the rate of the second internal LFO, which is mixed into the folding in every mode
Fold Left — sets the fold threshold used by the positive half of the first channel in Half Quant mode, and nothing else reads it
Fold Right — sets the fold threshold for both channels in the Fold, Quant Fold and Half Quant modes

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack above it.
